prompt: Build the Chinese internet meme character 大笑奶龙 (Laughing Nailong, also called 奶蛙) in 3D with three.js from memory, as it appears in the meme. No reference image is provided. Task (3D, static, from memory): write an HTML page that builds the character from code and renders it from your reference camera. For this static task, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>大笑奶龙</title>
<style>
  html, body { width: 240px; height: 240px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 240px; height: 240px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xfffcf6);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 240);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1.54, 1.54, 1.54, -1.54, 0.1, 30);
ref.position.set(0.64, 2.55, 7.9);
ref.lookAt(0, 1.375, 0.08);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff7e7, 0xfac78b, 1.65));

function directional(color, intensity, x, y, z) {
  const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(color, intensity);
  light.position.set(x, y, z);
  scene.add(light);
}
directional(0xfff4de, 2.15, -3.5, 6, 5);
directional(0xfff9ed, 1.10, 3, 4, -4);
directional(0xe9f2ff, 0.55, 4, 2, 4);

const character = new THREE.Group();
character.name = 'character-laughing-nailong';
scene.add(character);

const V = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
const color = hex => new THREE.Color(hex);
const lerp = THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
const smooth = (low, high, v) => THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(v, low, high);

function group(parent, name, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) {
  const result = new THREE.Group();
  result.name = name;
  result.position.set(x, y, z);
  parent.add(result);
  return result;
}

function surface(rows, segments, sample, reverse = false) {
  const positions = [];
  const normals = [];
  const colors = [];
  const indices = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= rows; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
      const { p, n, c } = sample(i / rows, Math.PI * 2 * j / segments);
      positions.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      if (n) normals.push(n.x, n.y, n.z);
      if (c) colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < segments; j++) {
      const a = i * segments + j;
      const b = a + segments;
      const d = i * segments + (j + 1) % segments;
      const e = d + segments;
      if (reverse) indices.push(a, d, b, d, e, b);
      else indices.push(a, b, d, d, b, e);
    }
  }
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  if (normals.length) geometry.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
  else geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  if (colors.length) geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  return geometry;
}

const matte = (hex, roughness = 0.64) =>
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: hex, roughness });
const skinColors = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.64 });
const skin = matte(0xffcc2d);
const footSkin = matte(0xffc128);
const spineSkin = matte(0xf4a12a);

function mesh(parent, name, geometry, material) {
  const result = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  result.name = name;
  parent.add(result);
  return result;
}

const sphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 48, 32);

function oval(parent, name, material, position, scale) {
  const result = mesh(parent, name, sphere, material);
  result.position.set(...position);
  result.scale.set(...scale);
  return result;
}

function sweep(parent, name, points, radii, material, flatten = 1) {
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points, false, 'catmullrom', 0.5);
  const rows = 48;
  const frames = curve.computeFrenetFrames(rows, false);
  const geometry = surface(rows, 32, (t, angle) => {
    const section = t * (radii.length - 1);
    const k = Math.min(Math.floor(section), radii.length - 2);
    const r = lerp(radii[k], radii[k + 1], section - k);
    const i = Math.round(t * rows);
    const p = curve.getPointAt(t)
      .addScaledVector(frames.normals[i], Math.cos(angle) * r)
      .addScaledVector(frames.binormals[i], Math.sin(angle) * r * flatten);
    return { p };
  }, true);
  return mesh(parent, name, geometry, material);
}

const body = group(character, 'body');
const bodyGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 112, 80);
const bodyPositions = bodyGeometry.attributes.position;
const bodyTints = [];
const bodyGold = color(0xffcb27);
const bodyLight = color(0xffd741);
const bellyCream = color(0xffeeb2);

for (let i = 0; i < bodyPositions.count; i++) {
  const nx = bodyPositions.getX(i);
  const ny = bodyPositions.getY(i);
  const nz = bodyPositions.getZ(i);
  const width = 1 - 0.18 * ny;
  const x = nx * 0.754 * width;
  const y = 0.895 + ny * 0.776;
  const z = -0.108 + nz * 0.605 * width;
  bodyPositions.setXYZ(i, x, y, z);

  const bellyRadius = Math.hypot(x / 0.54, (y - 0.824) / 0.534);
  const belly = (1 - smooth(0.965, 1.025, bellyRadius)) * smooth(0.12, 0.42, nz);
  const c = bodyGold.clone().lerp(bodyLight, 0.32 * smooth(-0.55, 0.85, ny));
  c.lerp(bellyCream, belly);
  bodyTints.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
}
bodyGeometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(bodyTints, 3));
bodyGeometry.computeVertexNormals();
mesh(body, 'round-torso-and-cream-belly', bodyGeometry, skinColors);

for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const label = side < 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
  const foot = group(character, `${label}-foot`, side * 0.414, 0.161, 0.258);
  foot.rotation.y = side * 0.25;
  oval(foot, 'flat-rounded-foot', footSkin, [0, 0.009, 0.066], [0.307, 0.166, 0.403]);

  const lift = side < 0 ? 0.13 : 0;
  const arm = group(character, `${label}-arm`, side * 0.58, 1.235, 0.025);
  sweep(arm, 'bent-arm', [
    V(0, 0, 0),
    V(side * 0.166, -0.136, 0.025),
    V(side * 0.267, -0.255 + lift * 0.36, 0.135),
    V(side * 0.334, -0.229 + lift * 0.76, 0.305),
    V(side * 0.357, -0.163 + lift, 0.390)
  ], [0.119, 0.167, 0.166, 0.150, 0.068], skin, 0.92);
  const hand = group(arm, `${label}-hand`, side * 0.350, -0.172 + lift, 0.391);
  hand.rotation.set(-0.40, side * -0.24, side * -0.20);
  oval(hand, 'rounded-palm', skin, [0, 0, 0], [0.150, 0.153, 0.135]);
  oval(hand, 'thumb', skin, [-side * 0.096, 0.028, 0.049], [0.072, 0.077, 0.074]);
}

const tail = group(character, 'tail', 0, 0.535, -0.39);
sweep(tail, 'curved-tapered-tail', [
  V(0, 0.03, 0),
  V(0.032, -0.066, -0.37),
  V(0.139, -0.150, -0.74),
  V(0.310, -0.132, -1.08),
  V(0.443, -0.020, -1.29),
  V(0.470, 0.063, -1.36)
], [0.319, 0.274, 0.202, 0.132, 0.075, 0.001], skin, 0.9);

const back = group(character, 'dorsal-ridges');
const ridgePoints = [
  [0, 1.438, -0.530, 0.114, 0.121, 0.101, -0.34],
  [0, 1.196, -0.641, 0.124, 0.124, 0.108, -0.55],
  [0, 0.950, -0.703, 0.128, 0.112, 0.113, -0.78],
  [0.044, 0.713, -0.844, 0.120, 0.120, 0.116, -0.27],
  [0.133, 0.571, -1.112, 0.101, 0.113, 0.109, 0.05],
  [0.266, 0.527, -1.402, 0.083, 0.095, 0.092, 0.12],
  [0.392, 0.553, -1.615, 0.061, 0.071, 0.070, 0.21]
];
for (const [x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, angle] of ridgePoints) {
  const ridge = oval(back, 'rounded-orange-ridge', spineSkin, [x, y, z], [sx, sy, sz]);
  ridge.rotation.x = angle;
}

const head = group(character, 'head', 0.013, 1.895, 0.067);
head.rotation.set(-0.06, -0.015, -0.034);

function headWidth(y) {
  return 1.038 + 0.082 * Math.exp(-((y - 0.43) ** 2) / 0.14)
    + 0.048 * Math.exp(-((y + 0.43) ** 2) / 0.10);
}

function skull(q) {
  const muzzle = Math.max(0, q.z) * 0.124 *
    Math.exp(-4.6 * q.x * q.x - 13 * (q.y + 0.075) ** 2);
  return V(q.x * headWidth(q.y), q.y * 0.834,
    0.023 + 0.046 * q.y + q.z * (0.665 + 0.025 * q.y) + muzzle);
}

function front(x, y) {
  const qy = y / 0.834;
  const qx = x / headWidth(qy);
  return skull(V(qx, qy, Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - qx * qx - qy * qy))));
}

function aperture(angle) {
  const s = Math.sin(angle);
  return {
    x: 0.816 * Math.cos(angle),
    y: -0.106 + (s >= 0 ? 0.101 * s - 0.117 * s ** 5 : 0.536 * s)
  };
}

const headGold = color(0xffcf2d);
const muzzleGold = color(0xffd842);
const cheekGold = color(0xffab2a);

function headSample(q) {
  const p = skull(q);
  const axis = Math.abs(q.y) < 0.95 ? V(0, 1, 0) : V(1, 0, 0);
  const u = axis.cross(q).normalize();
  const v = q.clone().cross(u);
  const tangent = dir => skull(q.clone().addScaledVector(dir, 0.001).normalize())
    .sub(skull(q.clone().addScaledVector(dir, -0.001).normalize()));
  const n = tangent(u).cross(tangent(v)).normalize();
  const muzzleLight = 0.65 * smooth(0.19, 0.88, q.z) *
    Math.exp(-2.2 * q.x ** 2 - 2 * (q.y + 0.16) ** 2);
  const blush = 0.57 * smooth(0.15, 0.65, q.z) *
    Math.exp(-((Math.abs(p.x) - 0.805) ** 2) / 0.026 - ((p.y + 0.197) ** 2) / 0.030);
  const c = headGold.clone().lerp(muzzleGold, muzzleLight).lerp(cheekGold, blush);
  return { p, n, c };
}

const headGeometry = surface(100, 224, (t, angle) => {
  const cs = Math.cos(angle);
  const sn = Math.sin(angle);
  if (t <= 0.50) {
    const edge = aperture(angle);
    const rimY = edge.y / 0.834;
    const rimX = edge.x / headWidth(rimY);
    const weight = Math.sin(t * Math.PI);
    const x = lerp(rimX, cs, weight);
    const y = lerp(rimY, sn, weight);
    return headSample(V(x, y, Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - x * x - y * y))));
  }
  const phi = (t - 0.50) * Math.PI;
  return headSample(V(cs * Math.cos(phi), sn * Math.cos(phi), -Math.sin(phi)));
});
mesh(head, 'sculpted-head', headGeometry, skinColors);

const mouth = group(head, 'wide-laughing-mouth');
const rimColor = color(0xe89b26);
const lipColor = color(0xad4421);
const interiorColor = color(0x60151b);
const depthColor = color(0x321013);

mesh(mouth, 'recessed-mouth-cavity', surface(37, 224, (t, angle) => {
  const edge = aperture(angle);
  const p = front(edge.x, edge.y);
  const scale = Math.cos(t * Math.PI / 2);
  p.x *= scale;
  p.y = -0.327 + (p.y + 0.327) * scale;
  p.z = lerp(p.z, 0.229, t) + 0.024 * Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(t * 6, 1));
  const c = rimColor.clone().lerp(lipColor, smooth(0, 0.105, t));
  c.lerp(interiorColor, smooth(0.07, 0.28, t));
  c.lerp(depthColor, smooth(0.20, 0.89, t));
  return { p, c };
}, true), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  vertexColors: true,
  roughness: 0.87,
  emissive: 0x270708,
  emissiveIntensity: 0.22
}));

const teeth = group(mouth, 'upper-teeth');
mesh(teeth, 'curved-ivory-row', surface(64, 28, (t, angle) => {
  const u = 2 * t - 1;
  const x = u * 0.570;
  const edge = aperture(Math.acos(x / 0.816));
  const taper = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u));
  const notch = 0.008 * Math.exp(-560 * u * u);
  const depth = front(x, edge.y).z - 0.068;
  const p = V(x,
    edge.y - 0.044 * taper + 0.043 * taper * Math.sin(angle)
      + notch * Math.max(0, -Math.sin(angle)),
    depth + 0.041 * taper * Math.cos(angle));
  return { p };
}), matte(0xfff0cb, 0.47));

const tongue = group(mouth, 'tongue', 0, -0.480, 0.489);
const tongueGeometry = sphere.clone();
const tonguePositions = tongueGeometry.attributes.position;
const tongueColors = [];
const tongueBase = color(0xe64b49);
const tongueLight = color(0xff8874);
for (let i = 0; i < tonguePositions.count; i++) {
  const x = tonguePositions.getX(i);
  const y = tonguePositions.getY(i);
  const z = tonguePositions.getZ(i);
  const groove = Math.exp(-66 * x * x) * smooth(0.16, 0.96, y);
  tonguePositions.setXYZ(i, x * 0.423, y * 0.132 - 0.019 * groove,
    z * 0.147 + y * 0.030 - 0.005 * groove);
  const c = tongueBase.clone().lerp(tongueLight, 0.65 * smooth(-0.2, 1, y));
  c.multiplyScalar(1 - 0.10 * groove);
  tongueColors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
}
tongueGeometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(tongueColors, 3));
tongueGeometry.computeVertexNormals();
mesh(tongue, 'rounded-tongue', tongueGeometry, skinColors);

function faceStroke(parent, name, material, trace, width, relief, base) {
  const geometry = surface(48, 20, (t, angle) => {
    const p = trace(t);
    const previous = trace(t - 0.001);
    const next = trace(t + 0.001);
    const dx = next.x - previous.x;
    const dy = next.y - previous.y;
    const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const taper = Math.sin(Math.PI * t) ** 0.62;
    const cross = Math.sin(angle) * width * taper;
    const point = front(p.x - dy / length * cross, p.y + dx / length * cross);
    point.z += base + Math.cos(angle) * relief * taper;
    return { p: point };
  });
  mesh(parent, name, geometry, material);
}

const lidSkin = matte(0xffc137);
const crease = matte(0x562a18, 0.71);
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const eye = group(head, side < 0 ? 'left-eye' : 'right-eye');
  function eyeTrace(t, offset = 0) {
    const u = (2 * t - 1) * side;
    return {
      x: side * (0.418 + 0.207 * u),
      y: 0.262 + 0.135 * (1 - u * u) - 0.034 * u + offset
    };
  }
  faceStroke(eye, 'raised-yellow-eyelid', lidSkin, t => eyeTrace(t, 0.010),
    0.051, 0.026, -0.004);
  faceStroke(eye, 'squeezed-shut-eye', crease, eyeTrace,
    0.034, 0.013, 0.020);
}

const nose = group(head, 'muzzle');
const nostril = matte(0xd59424, 0.78);
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  faceStroke(nose, 'tiny-nostril', nostril, t => {
    const u = 2 * t - 1;
    return { x: side * 0.145 + 0.032 * u, y: 0.038 - side * u * 0.010 };
  }, 0.010, 0.004, -0.001);
}

function contactShadow(x, z, width, depth, opacity, height) {
  const geometry = surface(27, 80, (r, angle) => ({
    p: V(x + Math.cos(angle) * width * r, height, z + Math.sin(angle) * depth * r)
  }), true);
  const rgba = [];
  const tint = color(0x71512d);
  for (let i = 0; i <= 27; i++) {
    const r = i / 27;
    const alpha = opacity * (1 - r * r) ** 3;
    for (let j = 0; j < 80; j++) rgba.push(tint.r, tint.g, tint.b, alpha);
  }
  geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(rgba, 4));
  const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
    vertexColors: true, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide
  });
  mesh(scene, 'soft-ground-shadow', geometry, material);
}

contactShadow(0.06, -0.165, 1.42, 1.19, 0.19, -0.006);
contactShadow(-0.42, 0.34, 0.55, 0.49, 0.23, -0.004);
contactShadow(0.42, 0.34, 0.55, 0.49, 0.23, -0.003);

function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}

render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref }, characters: [character], render, ready: true };
</script>
</body>
